easy: To change the time or date of a plan.

ex.ko: 만화 그리기는 내가 제일 좋아하는 취미이다.

easy: A very strong fear of something that is not really dangerous.

ex.en: My cousin has a phobia of spiders.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 거미 공포증이 있다.

easy: A game where you shoot a metal ball up a sloping board and hit it with flippers to score points.

ex.en: We played pinball at the arcade.
ex.ko: 우리는 오락실에서 핀볼을 했다.

easy: The owner of a large farm called a plantation.

ex.en: The planter grew cotton on his huge farm.
ex.ko: 농장주는 거대한 농장에서 목화를 재배했다.

easy: Full and complete; with everyone there.

ex.en: All the members came to the plenary meeting.
ex.ko: 모든 회원이 전체 회의에 참석했다.

easy: A man who delivers the mail.

ex.en: The postman brought a letter from Grandma.
ex.ko: 우체부 아저씨가 할머니의 편지를 가져왔다.

easy: A made-up name someone uses instead of their real name.

ex.en: The writer used a pseudonym on her books.
ex.ko: 그 작가는 책에 필명을 썼다.

easy: A fancy train car for travel by day or night.

ex.en: We slept in a Pullman on the overnight train.
ex.ko: 우리는 밤 기차의 호화 침대 객차에서 잤다.

easy: A time or place of great suffering that is not forever.

ex.en: Waiting in the hot sun was purgatory.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 햇볕 아래서 기다리는 것은 고문 같았다.

easy: Thinking clearly and using good sense.

ex.en: Using rationality, she figured out the best plan.
ex.ko: 그녀는 이성적으로 생각해서 가장 좋은 계획을 찾아냈다.

easy: Words that tell someone sharply that they did something wrong.

ex.en: The coach gave him a rebuke for being late.
ex.ko: 코치님은 그가 늦었다고 꾸짖으셨다.

easy: To scold someone sharply.

ex.en: The teacher rebuked the boys for running in the hall.
ex.ko: 선생님은 복도에서 뛴 남자아이들을 꾸짖으셨다.

easy: An answer that tries to prove what someone said is wrong.

ex.en: In the debate, each team gave a rebuttal.
ex.ko: 토론에서 양 팀이 각각 반론을 펼쳤다.

easy: Kept cold in a refrigerator.

ex.en: Keep the milk refrigerated so it doesn't spoil.
ex.ko: 우유가 상하지 않게 냉장 보관해라.

easy: To put up a frame of poles and boards around a building so workers can reach high places.

ex.en: Workers scaffolded the building before painting it.
ex.ko: 인부들은 페인트칠하기 전에 건물에 비계를 설치했다.

easy: A little less than the full amount.

ex.en: Add a scant cup of sugar, not quite full.
ex.ko: 설탕을 한 컵이 좀 안 되게 넣어라.

easy: A girl who goes to school.

ex.en: The schoolgirl carried a pink backpack.
ex.ko: 그 여학생은 분홍색 책가방을 메고 있었다.

easy: Made from layers of sand, mud, or tiny bits that pile up over time.

ex.en: Sandstone is a sedimentary rock.
ex.ko: 사암은 퇴적암이다.

easy: In a very surprising, often bad, way.

ex.en: The test was shockingly hard.
ex.ko: 시험이 충격적일 만큼 어려웠다.

easy: Not wanting to work or do anything; laziness.

ex.en: His sloth kept him on the couch all day.
ex.ko: 그는 게을러서 하루 종일 소파에 누워 있었다.

easy: A person who secretly brings things into or out of a country against the law.

ex.en: The smugglers hid the gold in barrels.
ex.ko: 밀수꾼들은 금을 통 속에 숨겼다.

easy: A casual word meaning to steal something small.

ex.en: My brother snitched a cookie from the jar.
ex.ko: 남동생이 과자 통에서 쿠키 하나를 슬쩍했다.

easy: One of the two days of the year with the longest or shortest daylight.

ex.en: The winter solstice is the shortest day of the year.
ex.ko: 동지는 일 년 중 낮이 가장 짧은 날이다.

easy: With only a few things spread out over a big area.

ex.en: The desert is sparsely covered with cactus.
ex.ko: 사막에는 선인장이 드문드문 나 있다.

easy: A speech problem where a person repeats sounds or gets stuck on words.

ex.en: He worked with a speech teacher on his stutter.
ex.ko: 그는 말을 더듬는 것을 고치려고 언어 치료 선생님과 연습했다.

easy: To speak with pauses and repeat sounds.

ex.en: She stuttered when she was nervous on stage.
ex.ko: 그녀는 무대에서 긴장하자 말을 더듬었다.

easy: To divide something into smaller parts again.

ex.en: The teacher subdivided each group into pairs.
ex.ko: 선생님은 각 모둠을 다시 둘씩 나누셨다.

easy: To take one number away from another.

ex.en: If you subtract 3 from 10, you get 7.
ex.ko: 10에서 3을 빼면 7이 된다.

easy: A very famous fashion model.

ex.en: The supermodel walked down the runway.
ex.ko: 슈퍼모델이 런웨이를 걸었다.

easy: Being easily affected or harmed by something.

ex.en: Her susceptibility to colds keeps her home a lot in winter.
ex.ko: 그녀는 감기에 잘 걸려서 겨울에 집에 있을 때가 많다.

easy: The flat top of a table.

ex.en: She wiped the crumbs off the tabletop.
ex.ko: 그녀는 탁자 위의 부스러기를 닦아 냈다.

easy: Having to do with touch.

ex.en: The museum had a tactile display you could touch.
ex.ko: 그 박물관에는 손으로 만져 볼 수 있는 촉각 전시물이 있었다.

easy: The science of heat and how energy changes from one form to another.

ex.en: Engineers use thermodynamics to design engines.
ex.ko: 공학자들은 엔진을 설계할 때 열역학을 이용한다.

easy: A device that keeps a room at the temperature you set.

ex.en: Mom turned up the thermostat because it was cold.
ex.ko: 추워서 엄마가 온도 조절기 온도를 올리셨다.

easy: A computer screen you use by touching it with your finger.

ex.en: I tapped the touchscreen to start the game.
ex.ko: 나는 터치스크린을 눌러 게임을 시작했다.

easy: A small bunch of hair, feathers, or grass growing close together.

ex.en: The owl has tufts of feathers that look like ears.
ex.ko: 그 부엉이는 귀처럼 보이는 깃털 다발이 있다.

easy: To sell something cheaper than other sellers do.

ex.en: The new shop undercut the old one by selling cheaper toys.
ex.ko: 새 가게는 장난감을 옛 가게보다 더 싸게 팔았다.

easy: To show that something is important.

ex.en: The coach underlined the need to drink water.
ex.ko: 코치님은 물을 마셔야 한다고 강조하셨다.

easy: A line drawn under words.

ex.en: Put an underline under the title of the book.
ex.ko: 책 제목 아래에 밑줄을 그어라.

easy: Hard to understand or use.

ex.en: The old computer had an unfriendly menu.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 컴퓨터는 메뉴가 쓰기 어려웠다.

easy: Without official permission.

ex.en: Driving an unlicensed taxi is against the law.
ex.ko: 허가받지 않은 택시를 모는 것은 불법이다.

easy: Not making much or getting much done.

ex.en: The meeting was unproductive because everyone just argued.
ex.ko: 모두 말다툼만 해서 그 회의는 성과가 없었다.

easy: A small glass bottle for medicine.

ex.en: The nurse filled the needle from a tiny vial.
ex.ko: 간호사가 작은 약병에서 주사기에 약을 채웠다.

easy: A person who plays the violin.

ex.en: The violinist played a sweet song.
ex.ko: 바이올린 연주자가 감미로운 곡을 연주했다.

easy: A military leader who rules an area by force when the government is weak.

ex.en: In the story, a warlord ruled the mountain villages.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 한 군벌이 산골 마을들을 다스렸다.

easy: From where.

ex.en: Whence did this strange cat come?
ex.ko: 이 이상한 고양이는 어디에서 왔을까?

easy: Done on a sudden idea, not for a good reason.

ex.en: Her whimsical choice was to paint her room purple.
ex.ko: 그녀는 즉흥적으로 방을 보라색으로 칠하기로 했다.
